newsitem.title: USA: Gothic Energy buys stakes in properties.
newsitem.headline: Gothic Energy buys stakes in properties.

text.p: Gothic Energy Corp said it has reached an agreement to buy various working and royalty interests in about 100 producing oil and gas properties located in Major and Blaine Counties of Oklahoma.
The purchase price is $10 million, and the effective date of the transaction will be January 1.
Gothic said the net producing reserves being acquired are about 11.5 BCFE.
BCFE. Gothic will assume operations of 33 of the properties being acquired. Closing will occur in the first quarter of 1997.
Additionally, in an unrelated transaction, it has signed an agreement to acquire various working interests and operations of 30 gas wells located in Western Oklahoma and the Texas Panhandle.

The purchase price is $4.2 million, and the effective date of the transaction was November 1, with the closing anticipated before the end of 1996. The net proven reserves being acquired are approximately 5 BCFE.
